[gold]

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 10
engine smtbmc

result.detail: I submitted exactly one equivalence_setup file, as equivalence.run takes one eqy path. The setup does not write the approved rtl_source file names. It reads each sources entry by its plain name. There are no shell, exec, write or tee commands, and no absolute or outside-folder paths. Both versions declare module gray_counter. This is fine because gold and gate are elaborated in separate Yosys sessions.
